checks.text: With no palette generated, the page shows the heading "Color Palette", the text "No palette yet", and the button "Generate palette" is visible.

Typing `#FF0000` in the field labelled "Hex" and clicking the button "Generate palette" adds five swatches to the grid; the first swatch displays the text "#FF0000" and the second swatch displays the text "#00FF00".
After generating a palette from `#FF0000`, the field labelled "Hue" shows `0`, the field labelled "Saturation" shows `100`, and the field labelled "Lightness" shows `50`.
With a palette generated from `#FF0000`, clicking the button "Copy hex" on the first swatch changes that button's text to "Copied" for 2 seconds, and the clipboard contains `#FF0000`.
With a palette generated from `#FF0000`, clicking the button "Remove" on the swatch displaying `#00FF00` removes that swatch from the grid, leaving four swatches.
With a palette generated from `#FF0000`, the text "Contrast: 21.0" is displayed below the first swatch, indicating the WCAG contrast ratio against white.

Selecting "Analogous" in the select labelled "Scheme" and clicking "Generate palette" with the base color `#0000FF` adds five swatches; the first swatch displays `#0000FF` and the second swatch displays `#0080FF`.
Typing `128` in the field labelled "Hue", `100` in the field labelled "Saturation", and `50` in the field labelled "Lightness" updates the field labelled "Hex" to `#800080`.
Reload keeps the palette generated from `#FF0000`; after reloading, the grid still shows the swatch with the text "#FF0000" and the field labelled "Hex" contains `#FF0000`.
